newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay exchange in delayed start, index up 1.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bombay exchange in delayed start, index up 1.4 pct.

text.p: Trading got off to a delayed start at the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Monday due to a power failure, traders said.
The benchmark 30-share index was up 59.04 points, or 1.43 percent, at 4,192.28 minutes after opening.
Trading has been extended on Monday till 4.30 p.m. (1100 GMT), dealers said.
The BSE normally starts the trading session at 10.30 a.m. (0430 GMT) and ends at 3.30 pm. (1000 GMT).
